schema = "rtt.targets/1"
# Values copied from docs/theory/01_eliashberg_targets.md §0.4/§0.6 and 02_materials_profile.md §5
# (architecture §7.1). Every numeric threshold carries a source id (contract R7).

[tc]
source = "doc01#0.4"
T_star_K = 300.0                  # s1 = T_star/300
a0 = "433148145/100000000"        # old constants.py A0_FRACTION (certified, eta = 1e-9)
floor_source = "doc01#0.4:N1-ISO"

[envelope]                        # doc01#0.4:ENVELOPE, #0.6a
eps_sys = { value = 0.10, source = "doc01#0.2b", provisional = false }
eps_omega_min = { value = 0.02, source = "doc01#0.2b" }

[gvalid]                          # literal values of doc01#0.4 G-VALID; rtt.decide uses them as constants
source = "doc01#0.4:G-VALID"
nonadiabatic_max = 0.1
imag_mode_tol_K = 30.0
anharmonic_shift_max = 0.10
min_admitted_sigmas = 3
min_q_meshes = 2
max_delta = 0.5
iso_margin = 0.75                 # FiresISO / FiresNM margin (policy)

[nm]
source = "doc01#0.3, doc03#2"
g_table = "docs/theory/certificates"   # doc03 certified nm_*.json, exact m0_over_T2 (as lean/scripts/gen_nm_table.py)
# no lambda cap: beyond the last certified lambda_k the lambda = inf certificate is used

[aim]                             # doc01#0.5 RANK-AIM, ranking only
source = "doc01#0.5"
lambda = [2.0, 3.0]
A_K_min = 2060
m_K2_min = 6.0e6
omega_log_K_min = [1210, 2020]    # at lambda = 3 .. 2
omega2_K_min = [1460, 2010]

[hard]                            # doc02#5a
H1_metallic = { value = 0.0, gap_eV_max = 0.0, source = "doc02#5a:H1" }            # value = gap_eV_max (RC1 F1)
H2_nonmagnetic = { value = 0.05, moment_muB_tol = 0.05, source = "doc02#5a:H2", provisional = true }   # value = moment_muB_tol
H4_lambda_max = { value = 4.7, flag_above = 3.7, source = "doc02#5a:H4" }
H7_ehull = { window_eV = 0.35, route_required_above_eV = 0.10, zpe_for = ["H"], source = "doc02#5a:H7" }

[soft]                            # doc02#5b, ranking only
source = "doc02#5b"
S2_Hf_floor_H_channel = 0.5
S3_HDOS = [0.4, 0.6]
S6_space_groups = [191, 194, 139, 123, 166, 221, 223, 225, 227, 229]
S10_palette = ["H","Li","Na","Mg","Ca","Sr","Ba","Al","Sc","Y","La","Rh","Pd","Ir","Pt","Os","Au","Ag"]

[chemsys]
source = "doc02#5d"
list = "targets/chemsys_list.txt"           # enumerated X-Y-H and 5(c) systems

[decide]                          # switches for pending doc01#0.6a / Lean additions (rtt.decide.core)
source = "doc01#0.4, #0.6a (revision of 2026-10-29)"
w_lo_sum_check = true             # dosWF: sum_i w_i (1 - dW) <= 1 (doc01#0.6a)
moment_consistency = true         # wf: A^2 <= lam m / 4 (1 + 1/100) (doc01#0.6a)
nmg_certified = true              # NM-G [THM-C]: records [M-ISO, CERT-NM] (doc01#0.4, doc03)

schema = "rtt.tiers/1"
# Architecture §7.2 (owned by docs 10, 11, 13). Every numeric threshold has a source id (R7).

[S1]
n_atoms_max = { value = 20, source = "doc10#1 (MatterGen training <=20 atoms)" }
pseudo_dir = "~/pseudo/sg15"                # whitelist = elements with a file here

[S3]
ml_model = "MatterSim-v1.0.0-5M"
ehull_self_max_eV = { value = 0.60, source = "doc21#RC1-F15: 0.35 (doc02#5a:H7) + sqrt2*p95 0.092 (MatterSim-self vs DFT hull, 160 H-entries of H-Ir-Mg/H-Li-Mg/H-Ca-Pd; docs/design/data/21_hull_calibration.json) + 0.10 Mg offset (doc10#3.3) + ZPE p95 0.018 (n=11) = 0.598 -> 0.60", provisional = true }   # re-measure with more systems + A3-4 audit pairs
rank_cut_per_day = { value = 25, source = "doc12#8.3 (S4 capacity)" }
ml_phonons_remove = false                   # doc10#3.4; enforced false for H/Li/Be in code
alignn_weight_H_light = { value = 0.0, source = "doc11#2.3" }

[S4]
profile = "s4"
ehull_heur_max_eV = { value = 0.56, source = "doc22#RC1-c: 0.35 (doc02#5a:H7) + 0.10 ZPE allowance (H7 is ZPE-corrected, heuristic is not; doc02#4.1 'tens of meV/atom', H-rich upper end UNVERIFIED) + 0.10 s4-profile (60 Ry, coarse k) formation-energy error allowance (UNVERIFIED; to be measured vs ref_hull) = 0.55 -> 0.56", provisional = true }   # the quantity is E_form vs elements, a lower bound on E_hull

[S5]
source = "doc11#3.1"
profile = "coarse"
q = [4, 4, 4]                               # finest coarse mesh
q_meshes = [[3,3,3],[4,4,4]]                # doc13 T2-SCREEN: q3^3 + q4^3 required (coarser first)
plateau_sigma_min_Ry = 0.03
margin_M_c = { value = 2.0, source = "doc13#5 T2-SCREEN fallback (one coarse mesh, q>=4^3 only: 2*max_sigma A < A_target); doc11#4", provisional = true }
e_c = { value = 0.5, source = "doc13 T2-SCREEN: (1+e_c) A_hi,coarse < A_target on q3^3 and q4^3", provisional = true }   # doc13 §5: judgment, n = 4 materials

[S6]
source = "doc12#3.1 S6, R12#14"
profile = "full"
q_meshes = [[4,4,4],[6,6,6]]
force_tol_mRy_bohr = 1.0
stress_tol_kbar = 0.5
certify = { mode = "bracket", mu_hi = 0.13, mu_hi_report = [0.10, 0.13, 0.15], omega_c_factor = 10.0, source = "doc12#3.6" }

[audit]
source = "doc12#3.5"
A34_per_week = 10
A45_per_week = 2
A56_per_month = 1

[controls]
source = "doc12#4 R8"
recall_disable_below = 1.0

[retry]                                     # review RC1 F12/F13: DEFERRED/ERROR re-entry (rtt.engine.retry)
source = "RC1#F12,F13 (engineering policy, not physics)"
max_attempts = 3                            # failed attempts per (candidate, stage); rank_cut/budget do not count
backoff_h = 6.0                             # wait backoff_h * 2**(n-1) hours after the n-th failure

schema = "rtt.machine/1"
# Architecture §7.3 (written as valid TOML).

[lanes.G]
gpu = true
cpu_threads = 2

[lanes.S]
mpi_ranks = 4
jobs = 2          # two 2-rank jobs (doc 11 coarse runs used 2 ranks)

[lanes.F]
mpi_ranks = 4
jobs = 1

[env]
OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1
TORCH_DISABLE_NATIVE_JIT = 1
nice = 19

[disk]
scratch = "~/rtt_scratch"
min_free_GB = 80
prune_per_q = true

[derate]
contention = 0.85

[capacity]        # §8.2
physical_cores = 8
core_h_per_day = 192
gpu_h_per_day = 24
